author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@NotThatMelB Wow. Sounds amazing. I am actually running a GIS grant right now for New Haven Public School elementary and middle school teachers.

Personally I am exploring if a recent gypsy moth infestation (three year cycles) overlaps with power outage maps from last round of late blizzards. Due too curriculum most elementary teachers playing with CT maps. Middle School topics getting broad.

Great to see these students apply analytics and mapping to inquiry,

Guess that's major point. There is no tech industry. Every field need analytic folks (and every other tech job) so let's focus on the thinking and embed the skills into a growing world of content knowledge and inquiry.

Once you are secretary of interior we will create citizen scientists and embed our nation schools into out national parks and federal lands.
